title: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC: Transfer Switch Wires May Come Loose (1,783 affected)
summary: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Heartland Cyclone and 2019-2021 Road Warrior Toy Hauler recreational trailers.  The transfer switch wire securement lugs may have been improperly tightened during production, causing the wires to come loose.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Tires with Incorrect Load Rating/FMVSS 110 (185 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020 Alfa Romeo Giulia vehicles.  These vehicles may be equipped with tires that have a lesser load rating than intended for the vehicle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Alternator Power Cable Connection May be Loose (1,434 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Thomas Built EFX and HDX school buses.  The nut for the power cable stud on the alternator may not have been tightened properly, which can cause a loose cable connection.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: Broken Shaft Seal May Cause Loss of Power Steering (697 affected)
summary: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2020-2021 S-Series vehicles.  A machining defect may cause pressure to build in the power steering pump and break the shaft seal, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Incorrect Front Disc Brakes Installed (1 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling one 2020 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicle.  The front axle was equipped with the incorrect-size brake discs.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Rearview Camera Image May Be Blocked from View (442 affected)
summary: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd. (Rolls-Royce) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Rolls-Royce Phantom vehicles.  The Central Information Display may not raise to the correct position, resulting in a rearview camera image that is partially blocked from view.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Missing Drive Bushing May Cause Steering Loss (1 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of American, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling one 2021 ID.4 vehicle.  The steering gear may have an incorrectly assembled or missing drive bushing.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Improperly Tightened Brake Pipe Nut (1,285 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022 Tiguan vehicles.  The nut that secures the brake pipe near the right-front wheel well may be loose.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Broken Shaft Seal May Cause Loss of Power Steering (79 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2021 Granite and LR vehicles.  A machining defect may cause pressure to build in the power steering pump and break the shaft seal, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.

title: WHITE RIVER MARINE GROUP LLC: Tires May Contact Fenders (380 affected)
summary: Tracker Marine, LLC (Tracker) is recalling certain 2022 Ranger Trail T22RT178, T22RT178B, T22RT188, T22RT188B, T22RT188P, T22RT188PB, T22RT198P, T22RT198PB, T22VS1665, T22VS1682, T22VS1782, and T22VS1782B trailers.  The fenders may be improperly spaced, allowing the tires to contact the fenders.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Broken Shaft Seal May Cause Loss of Power Steering (3 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2021 VNL vehicles.  A machining defect may cause pressure to build in the power steering pump, breaking the shaft seal and resulting in a loss of power steering assist.

title: Supreme Corporation: Liftgate License Plate Light Alignment/FMVSS 108 (20 affected)
summary: Supreme Corporation (Supreme) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Wabash National Supreme Dry Freight Body vehicles equipped with certain Maxon GPTLR and GPTWR liftgates.  A license plate light may have been installed that aims rearward and not towards the license plate.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA: Lack of Acceleration (2,462 affected)
summary: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA (Yamaha) is recalling certain 2016-2021 FJR13 motorcycles.  The Engine Control Unit (ECU) programming installed under Recall 20V-813 (990141), that was designed to prevent gear damage, may prevent the engine from accelerating as intended.

title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: Seat Belts Not Installed Properly/FMVSS 210 (10,409 affected)
summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Allegro Breeze, Allegro Red, Allegro, Allegro Bus, Phaeton, and 2018-2021 Zephyr recreational vehicles.  The sofa seat belts may not have been installed correctly, which could result in unsecured passengers.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Window Air Bag Mounted Incorrectly/FMVSS 226 (46 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021 GLB 250 and AMG GLB 35 vehicles.  The driver-side window air bag may not have been mounted correctly to the lower area of the A-pillar.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Steering Wheel Bolt May Loosen Affecting Steering (5,700 affected)
summary: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc. (Isuzu) is recalling certain 2018-2021 Isuzu FTR and 2018-2021 Chevrolet 6500XD vehicles.  A bolt on the left front steering knuckle may come loose, resulting in an increased turning radius and difficulty steering to the left.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Inaccurate Fuel Gauge Reading (53 affected)
summary: Kia Motors America (Kia) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Stinger vehicles.  A software error in the instrument cluster may cause an inaccurate fuel gauge reading.

title: Cottrell, Inc.: Missing 4 Side Reflectors/FMVSS 108 (40 affected)
summary: Cottrell, Inc. (Cottrell) is recalling certain 2019-2022 2-Car Carrier vehicles.  Four side-rear reflex reflectors are missing.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamp, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Steering Control (479 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC. (DTNA) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Western Star 49X vehicles.  The steering shaft may not have been properly installed, causing it to separate from the steering gear.

title: Keystone RV Company: Incorrect Tire Information on Federal Label (133 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain Arcadia 3660RL fifth wheel travel trailers.  The Federal Identification Label has the incorrect tire size and tire pressure information.

title: Autocar, LLC: Hazard Lights Disabled with Ignition Off/FMVSS 108 (947 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Xpeditor vehicles.  The hazard lights will not function with the ignition turned off.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Tesla, Inc.: Driver's Air Bag Cushion May Tear (7,600 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2021 Model X and Model S vehicles.  The driver's air bag cushion may tear during deployment.

title: Ford Motor Company: High Voltage Battery May Fail (1 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling one 2021 Escape vehicle equipped with a 2.5L hybrid powertrain.  The high voltage battery may fail, resulting in a sudden loss of drive power.

title: Ford Motor Company: Incorrect Components in Rear Suspension Module (20 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021 Explorer and Lincoln Aviator vehicles.  Incorrect rear suspension module components may have been installed due to a labeling error.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Inoperable Defrosting/Defogging System/FMVSS 103 (22 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022 Ram 1500 vehicles.  These vehicles may have been built with incompatible heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems (HVAC), resulting in the windshield defrosting and defogging system being inoperable to drivers.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems."

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: Fuel Line Sensor Housing May Leak (409 affected)
summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2021 Quattroporte, Ghibli, 2021-2022 Levante, and 2022 MC20 vehicles.  The fuel line sensor housing may crack and leak fuel.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Disabled Air Bags (99,255 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Jeep Grand Cherokee L, 2022 Jeep Wagoneer, and Grand Wagoneer vehicles.  The Occupant Restraint Controller (ORC) may have incorrect software which can disable the driver, passenger, and knee air bags without warning.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Disabled Air Bags (35 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar Occupant Restraint Controllers, part numbers 68518544AE, 68518543AE, 68518542AF, 68476781AB, and 68425814AE.  The Occupant Restraint Controllers (ORC) may have incorrect software, which can disable the driver, passenger, and knee air bags without warning.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Disabled Passenger Air Bag (208,332 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2017-2020 A4 Allroad, A4 Sedan, 2018-2019 RS5 Coupe, 2019 RS5 Sportback, 2018-2020 A5 Cabriolet, A5 Coupe, A5 Sportback, S4 Sedan, S5 Cabriolet, S5 Coupe, and Audi S5 Sportback vehicles.  The cable connecting the seat heater to the Passenger Occupant Detection System (PODS) may have a contact fault, causing the software to misdiagnose a malfunction and disable the passenger air bag.

title: Mazda North American Operations: Fuel Pump May Fail (121,038 affected)
summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2018 Mazda3, Mazda6, 2019 CX-3, 2018-2019 MX-5, CX-5, CX-9, and 2019-2020 Mazda2 vehicles.  The impeller inside the low-pressure fuel pump may crack and deform, potentially causing the fuel pump to fail.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Trailer and Tow Vehicle May Separate (325 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Continental and Cargo Mate Cargo trailers.  The coupler was improperly welded, which may cause the trailer to separate from the tow vehicle.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Tire Size and GAWR Rating/FMVSS 110 (31 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Cherokee ACKT29TEBL travel trailers.  The tire size and Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) on the Federal Placard are incorrect, which could result in the vehicle being overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Fuel Line Sensor Housing May Leak (11,419 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Alfa Romeo Stelvio, and Alfa Romeo Giulia vehicles.  The fuel line sensor housing may crack and leak fuel.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Fuel Pump May Fail (1,622 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019 Fiat 124 Spider vehicles.  The impeller inside the fuel pump may be deformed, potentially causing the fuel pump to fail.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Pressure Fuel Pump May Fail (222,410 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Ram 2500, 3500 pickup trucks, and Ram 3500, 4500, and 5500 cab chassis vehicles equipped with Cummins 6.7L Turbo Diesel engines.  The High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) may fail, resulting in a sudden engine stall without warning.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Pressure Fuel Pump May Fail (9,657 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar High Pressure Fuel Pumps and certain Mopar 6.7L Cummins Turbo Diesel Engines.  Please see the Part 573 recall report for a full list of affected part numbers.  The High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) may fail, resulting in a sudden engine stall without warning.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Missing Cross-Member Bolt in Engine Compartment (4 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo) is recalling certain 2021 XC40 BEV vehicles.  A bolt that secures the cross-member bracket for the electrical motor in the engine compartment may be loose or missing.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Power Stud May Electrically Arc to Bulkhead (6,100 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Western Star 4700, 4900, 5700, and 6900 trucks.  The affected trucks have a power stud that passes through the bulkhead.  In certain circumstances, the power stud may contact the bulkhead and result in an electrical arc.

title: Timpte, Inc.: iABS Securing Screws Improperly Tightened (67 affected)
summary: Timpte, Inc. (Timpte) is recalling certain 2022 Bulk Commodity Hopper trailers.  The screws that secure the bracket cover and end cover of the iABS Electronic Control Unit (ECU) may have been improperly tightened, which can allow the screws to loosen and back out, resulting in a loss of pressure in the unit.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Pedestal and Truck Frame May Separate (4,055 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2012-2016 AT200A aerial devices.  Cracks may develop in the legs of the mounting frame, which can cause the mounting frame side plate to break.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Broken Shaft Seal May Cause Loss of Power Steering (44 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2021 Class A Cornerstone motorhomes.  A machining defect may cause pressure to build in the power steering pump and break the shaft seal, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Rear Suspension Fasteners Not Tightened Properly (625 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Anthem, Embark, Reatta, and Reatta XL motorhomes.  The rear suspension mounting fasteners that attach the rear-drive axle to the rear suspension may not have been tightened properly, which could allow the fasteners to loosen or break.

title: M H EBY: Missing Conspicuity Tape/FMVSS 108 (836 affected)
summary: M H Eby is recalling certain 2020-2022 EBY Generation trailers.  The top rear corners are missing the white conspicuity tape.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamp, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Cummins, Inc.: Circuit Breaker May Not Function Properly (847 affected)
summary: Cummins Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Power Generation C70D2RE and C100D2RE trailer-mounted generator sets.  Certain Molded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCBs) may have been manufactured improperly, which can result in inadequate circuit protection.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Possible Sudden Loss of Braking Assist (227,490 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2018-2019 Camry vehicles.  The vane cap inside the vacuum pump may break, causing the pump to fail, which could result in a sudden loss of braking assist.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Incorrect Seat Belt Webbing Guide Installed (2,259 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022 Sienna vehicles equipped with seating for eight passengers.  An incorrect seat belt webbing guide may have been installed on the outboard second-row seat belt assemblies.

title: Sutphen Corporation: Broken Shaft Seal May Cause Loss of Power Steering (20 affected)
summary: Sutphen Corporation (Sutphen) is recalling certain 2020 Sutphen Fire trucks.  Pressure may build in the power steering pump and break the shaft seal, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Blocked Drain Tube May Cause Air Bag Deployment (54,429 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2021 Atlas and 2020-2021 Atlas Cross Sport vehicles.  The air conditioning system drain tube could be blocked, causing water to leak inside the vehicle near the air bag control module.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Seat Belt Locking Retractor Malfunction/FMVSS 208 (49 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Jayco Swift and Entegra Ethos motorhomes.  The seat belt automatic locking retractors may deactivate early, which can prevent the child restraint system from securing properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Unapproved Tire and Rim Combination/FMVSS 120 (307 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2012-2021 Freightliner SD 108, Freightliner SD 114, 2016-2020 Freightliner Coronado, 2013 Western Star 6900, 2013-2022 Western Star 4700, Western Star 4900, and 2022 49X vehicles.  The tires and rims are not approved and rated for these vehicles from the Tire and Rim Association or tire manufacturer.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: Jayco, Inc.: Water Heater Exhaust Fumes May Enter Slide-Out (108 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2021 Jay Flight Octane travel trailers.  The water heater was installed in the incorrect location, which could result in exhaust fumes entering the slide-out area of the trailer.

title: Spartan Fire, LLC: Rear Axle Drive Pinion May Fracture (260 affected)
summary: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan Fire) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Gladiator, MetroStar and FC-94 emergency vehicles.  The rear axle drive pinion may fracture.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Seat Belt Retractor Malfunction/FMVSS 208 (4,346 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021 Accord Sedan, Accord Hybrid, CR-V, Ridgeline, 2022 Insight and CR-V Hybrid vehicles.  The automatic locking retractor on the second-row center seat belt assembly may deactivate improperly, which can result in an unsecured child restraint system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Insufficient Fuel May Cause Stall (357 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021 NC750XD motorcycles equipped with 6-speed dual clutch automatic transmissions.  The fuel injection control module software may be programmed incorrectly, which can result in insufficient fuel when stopping, or accelerating from a stop.

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Rear Axle Drive Pinion May Fracture (34 affected)
summary: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc. (Ferrara) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Inferno and Cinder emergency vehicles.  The rear axle drive pinion may fracture.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Upper Control Arm Not Tightened Properly (35 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2020 Taycan vehicles.  The front and rear upper control arm screw connections on the rear axle may be loose.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improperly Tightened Electric Heater Ground Bolts (17 affected)
